displayProductImage.name: displayProductImage
displayProductImage.description: Display car images with title and description to the customer. Automatically detects single images or multiple images in the specified folder and displays them appropriately.

parameters.description: Path to folder containing car images (e.g., '/images/cars'). System will automatically detect if it contains a single image or multiple images and display accordingly.
Car title or name (e.g., 'Volvo XC40 - Premium Compact SUV', 'Available Car Models')
Brief car description, key features, or additional details about the car(s)

usage_examples.scenario: Show specific car model (folder with single image)
Show all available cars (folder with multiple images)

parameters.title: Available Car Models
parameters.description: Browse our complete selection of vehicles

validation_rules: imageFolder must be provided and should be a valid folder path
System automatically detects single vs multiple images in the folder
Single image displays as traditional product view
Multiple images display as interactive gallery slider

displayProductLink.name: displayProductLink
displayProductLink.description: Display a clickable product link with title and description

parameters.description: URL to the product page or external link
Brief description of what the link leads to

dismissOverlays.name: dismissOverlays
dismissOverlays.description: Close and dismiss any currently displayed product images or links
